name: Bard
notes: Traveler's Call's Meep bonus damage and spawn cadence are resolved for an assumed Chime count of 20 (see assumed): the wiki states the flat Meep damage is BaseMeepDamage=30 plus DamagePerCheckpoint=6 for every ChimesPerUpgrade=5 Chimes collected, so at 20 Chimes that is 30 + 6*(20/5) = 54 (+40% AP); this derived total is listed under assumed since it depends on the assumed Chime count, not a single directly-quoted number.

The Meep spawn cooldown (BardPTooltip_D_nS.BaseMeepSpawnCD=8, reduced by the wiki's '8 to 4 for 5' progression at Chime thresholds 0/20/40/55/70) is read at the assumed 20-Chime tier as 7s; this selected value is listed under assumed for the same reason.

The max/starting Meep bank (the wiki's '1 to 9' progression at Chime thresholds 0/10/30/50/65/80/90/95/100, since the bin's MaxPacks=3 is scoped to W and does not match any P-scoped bin row) is read at the assumed 20-Chime tier as 2; this selected value is also listed under assumed.

Bard opens the fight with a full bank of 2 Meeps (see assumed); each attack consumes one Meep for bonus magic damage, dealt as a non-crit on-hit proc since the wiki does not say it can critically strike.
Cosmic Binding is cast on cooldown; only its primary-target damage is modeled, since the dummy fight has no terrain and no second enemy for the bolt to hit and double its damage/stun onto.

Caretaker's Shrine only heals/speeds an ally or self and never damages the dummy, so it is not cast; Magical Journey is a terrain traversal tool with no damage and is not cast; Tempered Fate explicitly deals 0 true damage on its stasis/stun, so it is also skipped.
Mana costs are not modeled: nothing in this rotation would run out of mana inside a 15 s fight at level 16.

assumed.why: a plausible mid-to-late-game Chime count for a level 16 Bard; only changes flat Meep damage and Meep spawn cadence in a single-target dummy fight, since the 5-Chime slow and 15/35-Chime splash tiers have no effect against one target
